headline: LAA @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 4.44 at ARI 3.44, with a projected total of 7.89. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.46 runs while ARI moved -1.07, changing the projected margin by +1.53 runs. The projected total fell -0.61, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Walbert Ureña has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jo Adell, Gabriel Moreno, Geraldo Perdomo, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
